entries.subject: DAMIT 994: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-994.txt. Model 994, version 2016-01-04, pole (286°, -50°), period 31.4626 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: AKARI AcuA
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — included as an explicitly approximate thermal size transfer. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 71.06 ± 0.94 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 112 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive solutions: model 995, pole ['101', '-66'], [Model 995](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/995) The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 995: pole (101°, -66°), 31.4625 h, version 2016-01-04. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "35.53 km (approximate thermal scale)" (akari-acua-v1) implies a diameter of 71.06 km, outside the added Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 91, DAMIT model 995 diameter 82 ± 1 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 995 fitted to 3 occultations). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
